hooks.statusMessage: Checking the pre-PR architecture review ran for HEAD
hooks.command: node -e 'const c=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).tool_input?.command??"";process.exit(/(^|[\s;&|(])git(\s+-{1,2}\S+(\s+[^\s-]\S*)?)*\s+push(\s|$)/m.test(c)?0:1)' || exit 0; h="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" && test "$(cat "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/arch-reviewed" 2>/dev/null)" = "$h" || { printf '%s\n' 'Push blocked: HEAD has not passed the pre-PR architecture review (AGENTS.md "Pre-PR Architecture Review"). Load the cgw-review skill and apply docs/agents/reviewing.md to the full branch diff (git diff origin/main...HEAD), not only the last commit. Fix every finding you can and commit the fixes. For a finding that needs a human decision, ask the user and do not push. When the review of the current HEAD reports no findings, or the user explicitly accepts the remaining ones, record it with: git rev-parse HEAD > "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/arch-reviewed" and push again.' >&2; exit 2; }
